Full closed gloves/long sleeves.
Update all4 poses consistently: standing, walking contact, twohand overhead hands above crown, twohand downward cleave. Same torso length hip-to-shoulder bones, same thin/fitted body gender. Adjust upper cloth/armor shape to support a SHORT NECK, do not solve by making head smaller/bigger or stretching body. In overhead pose, arms remain attached to shoulder sockets, hands clear crown, vertical sword upright.
Maintain original layout FOUR COLUMNS×ONE ROW1774×887, feet baselineY805, identical canvas framing and scale, each actor wholly within column, transparent background/no text/no effects. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters for eyes, hair strands, cloth seams, leather and iron, no soft painting or noise.
Slim male body, same original masculine lean silhouette.
